results.title: Laos Revokes Import Licences of Six Vehicle Companies
results.content: The Ministry of Industry and Commerce has revoked the import licences of six vehicle-importing companies, immediately barring them from importing four-wheel vehicles. A notice issued on 14 October did not give a reason for the decision. The ministry named GMS Trading, Shacman Truck Laos, Zaha Trust Trading & Service, PA Trading Import-Export Sole Co., Ltd, […]
